data: ESA's first Mars orbiter; Europe's first planetary mission
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.
Mars Express is a deep-space orbiter built by EADS Astrium in Europe. ESA's first Mars orbiter; Europe's first planetary mission. In service since 2003.
Europe's first mission to another planet; longest-running non-NASA Mars orbiter
First European Moon mission — solar-electric ion drive. Spiralled to the Moon over 13 months; deliberate impact 2006-09-03
First spacecraft to orbit a comet (67P)
First close-up images of a cometary nucleus — flew 596 km past Halley's Comet at 68 km/s in 1986
ESA flagship to Jupiter — first orbiter ever to settle around a Galilean moon (Ganymede, 2034)
First asteroid sample ever returned to Earth

ESA's first interplanetary mission. Carried Beagle 2 to its lost landing. The HRSC stereo camera continues to map Mars at 10 m/pixel; MARSIS subsurface radar discovered evidence of liquid water beneath the south polar cap in 2018.
